PP-OCRv6 text detection and recognition models (PaddleOCR, https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR),
shipped with the OCR add-on rayopdf-ocr in rayopdf-ocr-models/ (never part of rayopdf).

Copyright PaddlePaddle Authors. The model cards declare the Apache License, Version 2.0 (its
full text is the LICENSE file of this distribution).

Source: PaddlePaddle's official ONNX exports on Hugging Face, pinned by revision and SHA-256 of
inference.onnx:

  PaddlePaddle/PP-OCRv6_tiny_det_onnx    2ba1506c0380b8f0b03dd142459aac66d4421f6c  193bab7a04fca699a6c82e6abb5b81bdb28177f0abd4062552b04908dafb19f8
  PaddlePaddle/PP-OCRv6_tiny_rec_onnx    2612ab37152ae0a677521bae4e1e3d4fb4cf7c30  9ef676d6ed3c88256a2d92c640c44f25b0c40947e111b14b8be8f594091563e6
  PaddlePaddle/PP-OCRv6_small_det_onnx   28fe5895c24fd108c19eb3e8479f4ab385fbfc62  d73e0058b7a8086bbd57f3d10b8bcd4ff95363f67e06e2762b5e814fe9c9410e
  PaddlePaddle/PP-OCRv6_small_rec_onnx   b8f84f0b80c529de40b4fbb3544b84fa7233a513  5435fd747c9e0efe15a96d0b378d5bd157e9492ed8fd80edf08f30d02fa24634

Modifications: the networks are converted, unchanged in their weights, to ncnn's format by pnnx
20261020 (docker/ocr_models.py); dict.txt is the character list and config.txt the detection
thresholds of each model's inference.yml.
